what: Median land surface temperature of summer nights, by 60 m cell (ECOSTRESS, read at 70 m)
source: NASA ECOSTRESS ECO_L2T_LSTE version 2 (70 m), 295 night granules of June to September 2024-2026 between 21:00 and 06:00, read from the LP DAAC; the median of each 60 m cell's clear views (https://doi.org/10.5067/ECOSTRESS/ECO_L2T_LSTE.002)
